import subprocess
recipe = r"""
set -euo pipefail
HYPR=efb50993780079460b0cbed1363e2166a2de1d9f
T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/mado-u5-static.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf -- "$T"' EXIT
fetch(){ curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "$1" -o "$2"; }
b(){ if "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo true; else echo false; fi; }
echo "stub=$(b grep -q 'TODO: STUB' om.cpp)"
for x in /usr/share/wlr-protocols/unstable/wlr-output-management-unstable-v1.xml; do [ -r "$x" ] && echo present || echo absent; done
pacman -Q hyprland wayland-protocols wayland-utils 2>&1 || true
"""
p = subprocess.run(["bash","-c",recipe],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(p.returncode); print(p.stdout); print(p.stderr)
